newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Arts Optical share offer 261 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Arts Optical share offer 261 times subscribed.

text.p: Arts Optical International Holdings Ltd said on Monday its public offer of 19.8 billion shares at HK$1.00 per share was about 261 times subscribed.

Proceeds of the share offer, at some HK$74 million, would be used to expand the company's production capacity, acquire licences for recognised brand names, repay bank loans and provide general working capital, it said in a statement.
The share issue represents some 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital of 338 million shares and trading in the shares would begin on Friday, November 8.
